title: Open the focused pane's scrollback in nvim
notes: Ctrl+` writes the focused pane's buffer to a file and opens it in the project's nvim with --remote-tab, over a socket the editor pane now listens on. No keystrokes are sent to the editor: a config that swaps ; and : would have the app press ; and open nothing. nvim's path is resolved once, so the tab opens in about 45ms. Also fixed on the way: a quit nvim left the key hanging for 15s, and the temp file was world-readable. PR #35.
